clause: DESIGN R3.3 §8.2 L632 one reversible semantic+binding+DI delta; L641 undo/redo restore the normalized states; §7.2 L565 explicit dependency-checked deletion of an empty support, undo restores the actual deleted object/ID; §8.1.1 L610 archived importedDi
derivation: The vendored support case with imported support IDs (Process_A, its lane set with the empty external lane, the Collaboration with main participant and reference band, five bindings) is loaded with an archived importedDi record showing the two participants (descriptorDigest = H of the lot-5 descriptor pins sorted by id, sha256 = H({descriptorDigest, diagrams})). lane-delete (delete surface, explicit deletion intent) removes the empty external lane: its containment array lanes becomes the empty array (kept, harmonization F1) and the binding targeting it is removed with it, leaving four bindings; the report has no entry. Undo restores a snapshot byte-identical to the one before the batch, including the five bindings, the lane with its original ID and the presentation with the archived importedDi; redo restores the after-state byte-identically.
